_comment: Sound-effect cue sheet. 'prompt' feeds ElevenLabs sound generation (elevenlabs.cjs); 'at' are the reel timestamps (s) where audio.cjs places each effect.

slam.prompt: Deep cinematic trailer impact hit with sub boom and short metallic tail, punchy

whoosh.prompt: Fast cinematic whoosh swipe transition, airy and clean

repel.prompt: Magnetic repulsion force field pulse, sci-fi energy push outward

tick.prompt: Short crisp UI click tick, modern interface

cash_drain.prompt: Coins sliding and falling away, money disappearing, short

spotlight.prompt: Stage spotlight switching on with a soft electric hum then sliding away

flatline.prompt: Heart monitor beeping twice then a flatline tone

glitch.prompt: Digital glitch stutter, data corruption error burst

magnet_hum.prompt: Deep magnetic field hum with metallic shimmer, slowly rising

attract.prompt: Magical shimmer of coins and chimes being pulled together into one point

alarm.prompt: Low ominous warning tone, short and dark

clash.prompt: Two energy forces clashing with an electric crackle

resolve.prompt: Bright magical success chime, sparkly and uplifting

split_flap.prompt: Airport split flap display board flipping rapidly

card_slide.prompt: Thick paper card sliding fast onto a table, soft swoosh

ka_ching.prompt: Cash register ka-ching with coins, bright

typing.prompt: Fast smartphone touchscreen keyboard typing taps

tap.prompt: Smartphone screen tap button press, soft click

cascade.prompt: Quick ascending sparkle cascade of tiny chimes
